description: This file defines a React Native functional component named CategoryTabs, which renders a horizontal tab bar for selecting video categories. It accepts categories, the currently selected category, and an onSelect callback as props. The component uses React Native components like View, Text, TouchableOpacity, and ScrollView for layout and interactivity, and applies styling via StyleSheet.

methods.name: CategoryTabs
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a horizontal scrollable list of category tabs. Highlights the selected tab and calls onSelect when a tab is pressed.
